disclosures: Initial versioned pilot allowances; existing subscription terms are preserved when the catalog changes.
Scheduled monitoring checks consume the monthly search allowance once. Manual searches and scheduled checks are shown separately.
Reports consume both the report allowance and shared AI operations and reserved-token capacity. Provider and daily safety caps also apply.
Only configured, authorized data sources are available. AI capacity is reserved before requests; actual provider tokens are reported separately.
The actual PayU charge currency, one-time-payment availability and tax treatment must be confirmed before checkout opens.
Yearly prices await approval. A seven-day limited trial is available when work-email registration is open, with no card or automatic renewal.
Lead Engine is a separate future launch and is not included.
